referenceSources.description:
A rare Giallo Fly Diablo GTR is presented in a clean studio environment, emphasizing its aggressive rear design. The wide bodywork, center‑lock Speedline wheels, and large chassis‑mounted spoiler underscore its track‑focused upgrades over the standard Diablo GT. Badges reading “Lamborghini” and “GTR” flank the rear grille, and a “BINGO” plate hints at its auction listing.

Built for Lamborghini’s one‑make Supertrophy series in 2000, this example—chassis No. 18—retains its original 6.0‑liter V12, now tuned to nearly 600 horsepower. With only 6,770 kilometers on the odometer, it has passed through Germany, the United States, and Japan before being offered by Bingo Co. at an estimated ¥110,000,000–¥130,000,000 (approximately $697,228–$823,997 USD).
